title: Harrowgate Freight renewal call
scratchpad:
Colm wants 15% off, 1yr
competitor quote in play
CFO approval by end Oct
segments: Thanks for making time, Colm. Maya from our product team is joining too.
Happy to. I'll be direct, the renewal is coming up and finance is asking questions.
Understood. Today you're at forty two thousand dollars a year for sixty technician seats.
Right. And the double booking problem at the north depot cost us real money in August.
That's the sync delay between dispatch and the technician app. We fixed it in the September release.
Good to hear. But to renew at the same scope, we'd want fifteen percent off.
Routewise quoted us lower, and my CFO has seen that quote.
I appreciate you telling us. Is that fifteen percent on a one-year term?
One year. We might do longer if the number works.
What would make a longer term attractive for you?
Price certainty, and the route optimization module you showed us in the spring.
Whatever we agree, I need it approved by our CFO before the end of October.
I'll put together two options, one year and two year, and we'll walk you through them in three weeks.
Sounds good. Send the agenda ahead of time.

items.text: Current Harrowgate contract: $42,000 a year for 60 technician seats
Harrowgate asks for a 15% discount on a one-year renewal
Renewal must be approved by Harrowgate's CFO before the end of October
Prepare one-year and two-year renewal options and present them in three weeks
